metadata.title: Curvature Renormalization and Perfect-Reflection Stability by Curved Closed Stationary Waves
metadata.description: This release publishes a numerical constructive experiment on how odd-harmonic complex waves satisfying the all-positive zero closure Sigma x_n^2 = 0 are stabilized inside curved local cells. Curvature-induced relative phase leakage is shown to produce closure residuals and transmission leakage in transient states, while internal phase re-selection into closed stationary waves absorbs the leakage and recovers the complete-reflection readout of the preceding local exchange-interference map. The release includes Japanese and English manuscripts, TeX/PDF builds, executed numerical scripts, result JSON/CSV files, figures, and a reproducibility bundle.
metadata.notes: This paper does not claim a quantitative prediction of real spacetime curvature. Curvature is modeled as local relative phase leakage. The tested result is that the all-positive zero closure detects such leakage and that internal phase re-selection into closed stationary waves restores the exchange-interference complete-reflection readout.

title: Curvature Renormalization and Perfect-Reflection Stability by Curved Closed Stationary Waves
